answer: Make every newcomer arrive on a sponsor's liability. A new agent works only if an existing agent locks 30 tokens behind it, and that stake stays frozen until the newcomer finishes 20 jobs. If the newcomer is caught cheating, the sponsor loses stake in proportion to the delta between claimed and verified work, and the loss climbs the sponsor tree like timber falling down a slope. A clone farm must tie up capital for every fake ID, and the capital melts as slow as a glacier thaws. Stake and job counts are assumptions.
